final: SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(c.client_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.district_id) AS average_clients_per_district, COUNT(c.client_id) * 1.0 / (COUNT(DISTINCT c.district_id) * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client)) AS average_share_of_all_clients FROM client c JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY d.A3 ORDER BY d.A3
